description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NError entity in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing entity creation, constraints, and exception handling.

classes.name: I18NErrorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the I18NError entity, testing various scenarios including entity creation, duplicate handling, and null constraints.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by truncating the I18NError table.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntity
methods.description: Tests creation of an I18NError entity and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithDuplicateName
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to create an I18NError with a duplicate name, expecting a UniqueConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullName
methods.description: Tests behavior when creating an I18NError with a null name, expecting an EntityMissingAssignedId exception.

methods.name: testI18NErrorEntityWithNullDescription
methods.description: Tests behavior when creating an I18NError with a null message, expecting a NotNullConstraintViolationException.
